Subtract 332 days from 2014-04-21.  
2014-04-21 minus 332 days:  
Back up 21 days to 2014-03-31, then 311 days left.  
2014 is not a leap year, so back 365 days from 2014-03-31 is 2013-03-31, but we only need 311 days earlier from 2014-03-31:  
311 days before 2014-03-31 = 2013-05-24.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 2013-05-24
